fact: Chief Justice Sakoane said on 3 July 2026 that the Judiciary is implementing digital systems, including electronic filing of court documents, with the Ministry of Information.

The High Court Civil Litigation Rules 2024 (Legal Notice 65) define e-justice as an internet-based system for delivering process and maintaining court case files, with registered users, and leave the date it comes into operation to a Chief Justice notice in the Gazette.
